title: Exotic Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado
description: A savory and light Peruvian dish featuring beef strips, shichimi-togarashi, and vegetables, perfect for a crowd, this whole30-friendly recipe is a must try. It is a stir-fry dish that combines the flavors of Peru and Asia.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together shichimi-togarashi, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the beef strips to the marinade and mix well to coat, then let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Remove the beef from the marinade and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until they are tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Return the cooked beef to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the beef is heated through.
